title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Vehicle Census - Permit
description: Official permit, usually issued by the city council or the traffic authority, that allows a particular vehicle to access, drive through, or park in an area where entry is restricted or regulated (edintveh:Permit).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Permit'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

authorisesVehicle.description: Relationship. The Vehicle for which the permit is issued (edintveh:authorisesVehicle).

authorisesInSegment.description: Relationship. The street section where the permit authorises the vehicle to go through or park (edintveh:authorisesInSegment). The source ontology's range is an external 'Tramo' class from a different, older external ontology (ciudadesabiertas.es) that this candidate family's edint-infraestructura StreetSection entity has already superseded internally as of its v0.2.1 update -- kept pointing at StreetSection here rather than an unmodeled external class. This vehicle-census ontology has not itself been updated to reference that internal migration; see standard-metadata.yaml.

permitOwner.description: Relationship. The person or organisation for which the permit has been issued (edintveh:permitOwner). Same 'Owner' union-type handling as Vehicle.registeredOwner -- kept as an opaque Relationship.

permitPeriodicity.description: Property. Periodicity of the permit, from the VehiclePermitPeriodicity controlled vocabulary (edintveh:permitPeriodicity).

permitStatus.description: Property. Status of the permit, from the VehiclePermitStatus controlled vocabulary (edintveh:permitStatus).

permitType.description: Property. Type of permit, from the VehiclePermitType controlled vocabulary (edintveh:permitType).

activationDate.description: Property. The date on which the authorization is activated (edintveh:activationDate). xsd:date, no time component.

beginningDate.description: Property. Starting date of the authorization period (edintveh:beginningDate). xsd:date, no time component.

endingDate.description: Property. Permit expiration date (edintveh:endingDate). xsd:date, no time component.
